purpose: The citation list for paper/references.bib. Each entry names its identifiers and why it is cited; every bibliographic field is taken from the B5 source manifest (B5-reviewed papers) or from paper/bib_verification.json (Crossref / arXiv records), never typed here. Planned citations come from B5 (reviewed papers and HIGH-priority follow-ups), principal track A4 and P2, the Phase 8 allocation P3, and the Stage 3/4 reports.
